honest_framing: Arm H is a hybrid. The textbook learner brute.baseline/32t (Rivest-Schapire homing + L* + Vasilevskii-Chow, unchanged) proposes the hypothesis. Its own ID label assumes the homing sequence resynchronises. Brute's new SAT engine brute.certify/32x then tries to certify the hypothesis's current state under the declared state bound N alone (no reset, no resync assumption, clean readings). H's IDF is Brute's contribution; the hypothesis and most of the decoder steps are the textbook method's. The guarantee is conditional on the declared N.
question: Can a textbook hypothesis plus a SAT certificate reach the textbook method's N-12 coverage while assuming only N (not resync)?
heldout_note: GB stays held out (no tuning on it; it was not piloted for 32x)
target_software: experiments/targets_070.py (unchanged): real CPython incremental decoders, one object per job, no reset, 2-bit readings

api.H: brute.baseline/32t to its ID/stop, then brute.certify/32x on the SAME decoder stream (32x may run extra rival-splitting experiments on it)

certify32x.rival: any Moore machine with at most N states and 4 reading codes
certify32x.encoding: exactly-one transitions/emissions; leveled apartness ap_j[p][q] between rival state p and hypothesis state q, j up to N+n; one pinned contiguous suffix window [u,L] of the reset-free trace
certify32x.symmetry_breaking: window positions pairwise apart on the trace itself (same actions then different reading; hypothesis only guides the choice) are pinned to distinct rival states under a per-window guard literal
certify32x.loop: SAT: a rival fits the window and ends apart from the hypothesis state q*. If the rival is inconsistent with the full trace, double the window back. If it is consistent but apart, run its separating word as an experiment (K step budget). If a solve is capped, double the window. UNSAT -> IDF. Sound: the window is a relaxation of the full trace

design.jobs: H, T at plus1 and n12, B at plus1 only (B at N 12 was IDU or OOM-killed in 070, disclosed). Seed 12710101 (fresh); 25 jobs. Smoke seed 12710301 at plus1 only
design.memory: each job's child sets RLIMIT_AS = 1.8 GiB before running (runner-side, not in brute/). MemoryError or a signal exit -> KILL record (cap_hit true/false). At most 3 workers: 3 x 1.8 = 5.4 GiB, inside the ~6.9 GB the box has available (15.6 GB total). Budget from the pilots: the 070 OOM jobs peaked at 2.7-5.2 GB (now capped); the 32x pilots peaked at 129 MB (U3 N7) and about 2 GiB (U3 N12, out of memory at 19.8M clauses); the 100000-step window cap keeps the N-12 jobs near 1.1 GiB (Inferred from the clause counts)
design.time: SIGKILL at 900 s -> KILL record; main cap 4500 s; the main run happens once
